title: AI Configuration
description: Configuration for AI-assisted generation - AI generates structured output, commands handle formatting

defaults.description: Default settings inherited by all types (currently unused but reserved for future use)

types.description: Type-specific configurations keyed by type name

retryStrategy.description: Retry strategy configuration for AI generation

type.description: Retry strategy type: standard (retry on any retriable error), focused (retry on specific categories), escalating (increase urgency), escalating-focused (combine both)

focus_categories.description: Error categories to focus on (for focused/escalating-focused strategies)

typeConfig.description: Configuration for a specific AI generation type. AI generates structured output in output_format, then commands handle formatting.

description.description: Description of what this type generates

output_format.description: REQUIRED: Output format. AI generates structured content in this format (validated against schema). Commands then format the output deterministically.

data.description: Reference data files to inject into prompt (key: path)
